asr.full_text: What is Bitcoin? The first decentralized digital currency Bitcoin is a digital coin that you can send online In comparison with other currencies, bitcoins have several advantages Bitcoins are transmitted from person to person via the network through a banking or processing centre This means small commissions You can use Bitcoins anywhere your account can't be frozen and there are no mandatory conditions or other restrictions Let's see how it works You can take a loan of 30%, but if you decide to give up your account due to your situation, it's better not to risk the whole amount of money. 5. The most common investment factor for a Bitcoin account is your money savings account. The best bet is a $50 bank loan, but there is no doubt about it. It's very rare in the world for a Bitcoin account to be 100% guaranteed, but when you invest in such a thing your money is guaranteed. The best investment is to have an account bitcoin is stored in your digital wallet, which you probably knew if you have used internet banking. When you pass the Bitcoins to them, a digital signature is added. After a few minutes, the transaction is confirmed by the generators and for forever they are anonymously saved on the network. The software for working with Bitcoins has an open source code and anyone can learn it. Bitcoin changes finances and the any learner can use it. Bitcoin is changing finances as well as the Internet has changed news and print. If every player has access to the global market, everybody has a chance to win! Let's look at a few examples of how Bitcoin is used today. You can buy video games, presents, books, servers, and socks from Alpaca There are several currency exchanges where you can trade with for dollars, euros and so on. Bitcoin is an excellent way for small businesses to find a freelancer, you don't have to pay their reception, there is no interest and transaction fees and you receive an additional order for an additional bid by participating in the bitcoin economy. To receive more information and your first bitcoins visit btcx.com for Russian users

The Bitcoin educational material and illustrative transfer graphics do not establish a real transaction or identify the recipient and terms.
